# Jayesh Soni - Portfolio & AI Product Engineering Directory

> Product Lead & AI Product Designer specializing in Enterprise AI Workforce systems, Human-AI Collaboration, and Interaction Architecture.

## Executive Summary
Jayesh Soni designs the moments where people decide whether to trust intelligent systems. His work spans scaling AI from individual agents to enterprise-grade workflows, designing trustworthy AI interactions, and crafting autonomous monitoring systems.

- **Website**: https://jayeshsoni.com
- **Role**: Product Lead & AI Product Designer
- **Specialization**: Enterprise AI Workforce, Generative Workflows, Human-AI Collaboration, Interaction Design

## Key Case Studies & Projects

- [Allyra.ai Story](https://jayeshsoni.com/allyra-story): Scaling AI from individual agents to enterprise-grade workflows. Features agent orchestra orchestration, governance, and enterprise deployment.
- [Campaign OS Story](https://jayeshsoni.com/campaign-os-story): Designing an autonomous marketing & campaign operating system. Features connected workflows, conversational analytics, and calm monitoring.
- [tulah](https://jayeshsoni.com/#story-03-block): Simplifying wellness operations through thoughtful workflow design.
- [VousVous](https://jayeshsoni.com/#story-04-block): Designing trustworthy AI interactions for modern relationships.
- [Joonify](https://jayeshsoni.com/#story-05-block): Early-stage AI product design and talent discovery platforms.

## Core Design & Product Principles

1. **Reliable Outcomes over Autonomous Hype**: People don't want autonomous AI for its own sake; people want reliable outcomes built on well-designed collaboration between humans and AI.
2. **Progressive Disclosure**: Reducing cognitive load through contextual side panels, progressive disclosure, and calm monitoring.
3. **Conversational Analytics**: Transforming static analytics dashboards into dynamic, conversational AI interactions.
4. **Calm Monitoring**: Surfacing autonomous monitoring alerts only when human intervention is genuinely needed.
